capabilities: Sync the vault with Google Drive using the user's own OAuth credentials
Merge conflicting note edits word by word via a three-way merge against the last synced version
Preview a sync plan with a dry run before executing it
Move deleted files to trash on both local and Drive sides
Connect mobile devices through a generated connection code
extras: Setup requires creating a Google Cloud project and OAuth client by hand (about five minutes); mobile sign-in must be done from a desktop first. The README addresses Obsidian's automated plugin review flags (vault enumeration, clipboard use) and includes donation links.
problem: Most sync tools handle simultaneous edits to the same note by producing a conflicted copy or silently picking one version, losing work either way.

relations.evidence: It talks to Drive with your own credentials.
The merge engine is shared with the AI Co-Editor plugin and covered by its test suite.

requires.name: Self-created Google OAuth client ID and secret

summary: Google Drive sync plugin that resolves conflicting note edits with a word-level three-way merge instead of creating conflicted copies.
